headline: Sexual Wellness Training, from entry to detail
overview: Sexual Wellness Training is a progressive, structured program focused on developing physical control and psychological confidence in intimate contexts. The curriculum is designed as a sequence of practices that build on each other, helping users develop greater body awareness, emotional regulation, and relational attunement over time.
targetAudience: Users interested in relationships tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Progressive training curriculum building physical control and psychological confidence
Structured practice sessions with clear guidance for each stage
Session tracking to monitor consistency and progress through the program
Body awareness and emotional regulation techniques integrated throughout
tips: Progress through the curriculum in order — each stage builds on the previous one
Consistency matters more than intensity; short regular practice is more effective than occasional long sessions
